label: Series impedance magnitude
subgoals: Compute the inductive and capacitive reactances at the frequency
Subtract them to get the net reactance
Combine the net reactance with R by the Pythagorean sum

label: Admittance and parallel combinations
subgoals: Convert each parallel element to its admittance
Add the admittances as complex numbers
Invert the total admittance to get the impedance

label: Phase angle of an impedance
subgoals: Compute the net reactance of the impedance
Take the arctangent of reactance over resistance
Read the sign as inductive or capacitive behavior
